questions.question: Eight friends A, B, C, D, E, F, H and G are sitting around a circular table facing each other for a group discussion. A is opposite F and second to the right of E. G is between C and A. H is to the left of E. Who is sitting to the immediate left of A?
questions.solution:
**Eight friends **A, B, C, D, E, F, H and G

1) A is opposite F and second to the right of E. G is between C and A. H is to the left of E**.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f6a2f4f1bdbbc0fabeb72862b89b0867441baf83ff25ecdf19cd97880474255b.png] **

2) H is to the left of E**. **Hence, H can not be to the right of E and left friends are B & D with us.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/653fa4377c514aadb0e22ccbf55bbc20ed30bf610183bda3b0bb71e2da761bbd.png] 

Hence, either B or D is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that will correctly replace the question mark (?) in the series.

12, 22, 42, 82, ?
questions.solution:
The pattern followed is :

12 + 10 = 22

22 + 20 = 42

42 + 40 = 82

82 + 80 = 162

Hence, ‘162’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term.

Blend : Mix :: Request : ?
questions.solution:
The first two words are synonyms of each other as follows:

Blend : Mix → Blend and mix both are synonyms having same meaning i.e. to mix.

Similarly,

Request : ? → Request and solicit both are synonyms having same meaning i.e. an act of asking for something

Hence, ‘solicit’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
**The statements below are followed by two conclusions labelled I and II. Assuming that the information in the statements is true, even if it appears at variance with generally established facts, decide which conclusion(s) logically and definitely follow(s) from the information given in the statements.**

**Statements:**

1) Some stores are rooms.

2) Some rooms are posters.

**Conclusion:**

I. Some rooms are stores.

II. Some posters are rooms.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor conclusion II follows.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as follows,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30281305280005e7d58c0837e7b06f4e9684e41372b5aeeff04e55908cbb29a6.png] 

Conclusion:

I. Some rooms are stores → True (Some stores are rooms)

II. Some posters are rooms → True (Some rooms are posters)

Hence, both conclusions I and II follow is the correct answer.

questions.question:
The statements below are followed by two conclusions labelled I and II. Assuming that the information in the statements is true, even if it appears at variance with generally established facts, decide which conclusion(s) logically and definitely follow(s) from the information given in the statements

Statements:

1) All customers are clients.

2) All clients are medicines.

Conclusion:

I. Some medicines are customers.

II. Some medicines are clients.

options.text: Either conclusion I or conclusion II follows.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as follows,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53c06c85be45ac4c0a91fe843809203b1d7f236df5157aefeec07e9c3d354394.png] 

I. Some medicines are customers → True (All customers are clients and all clients are medicines)

II. Some medicines are clients → True (All clients are medicines)

Hence, both conclusions follow.

questions.question: Seven friends O, P, Q, R, S, T and U are watching a cricket match sitting in a stadium. P is sitting at one extreme end. T is sitting between Q and U. R is sitting to the immediate right of S and immediate left of Q. U is sitting second to the left of P. Who is sitting between U and P?
questions.solution:
1) P is sitting at one extreme end and U is sitting second to the left of P that means P is sitting at the extreme right end.

2) U is sitting second to the left of P and T is sitting between Q and U

3) R is sitting to the immediate right of S and immediate left of Q

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/99753932e90359e3bac6db88593c067556ce705a194277760a1ab062918a7a68.png] 

Hence, O is the correct answer.

Initial : Final :: Mourn : ?
questions.solution:
The logic is:

Antonyms words are paired as follows:

Initial : Final → Initial is the state of beginning while final is the state of completion.

Mourn : ? → Mourn is a feeling to show extreme sadness while rejoice is a feeling of extreme happiness.

Hence, ‘rejoice’ is the correct answer.

questions.question: Choose the odd one out of the given options.
questions.solution:
The logic is:

Sum of the place values of all the letters in the group is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a9af5719da59eb48ae4ca591a42ddacf31b73f98752ff996cb13343d110e4619.png] 

A) RGD → 18 + 7 + 4 = 29

B) HIL → 8 + 9 + 12 = 29

C) EKM → 5 + 11 + 13 = 29

***D) QSC → 17 + 19 + 3 = 39***

Thus, sum of the place value of letters of all words is 29, except QSC.

Hence, **QSC** is the correct answer.

questions.solution:

x : x (x + 3)

Similarly,

Hence, ‘238’ is the correct answer.

questions.question: Choose the odd one out of the given options.
questions.solution:
The logic is:

**All are metals except 'Silicon' which is metalloid.**

**Option 1: Silicon**

**Silicon** is a **metalloid**, also called a semi-metal, which means it has properties of both metals and nonmetals. It is also commonly recognized as a metalloid **(i.e**. **a weak nonmetal**) since it is a semiconductor and has intermediate ionization energy and an intermediate electronegativity value.

Option 2: Magnesium

**Magnesium** is a** metal**. As a solid, the element has a shiny, gray appearance, which is one of the characteristics of elements in the** metal group on the periodic table.**

Option 3: Tungsten 

Tungsten, also known as Wolfram is **a metal.** **Tungsten metal** sits in the middle of the periodic table with a group of **metal elements called transition metals.** 

Option 4: Aurum

**Aurum**,** the Latin word for gold** and the source of its chemical symbol,** "Au". **Gold is very ductile and is the most malleable** metal.**

Hence, **'Silicon'** is the correct answer.

questions.question: In a certain code OPTIMIST is written as 121. How will PESSIMIST be written in that code?
questions.solution:
The logic is:

Addition of the place values of the letters in the word as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a9af5719da59eb48ae4ca591a42ddacf31b73f98752ff996cb13343d110e4619.png] 

OPTIMIST = 15 + 16 + 20 + 9 + 13 + 9 + 19 + 20 = 121

Similarly,

PESSIMIST = 16 + 5 + 19 + 19 + 9 + 13 + 9 + 19 + 20 = 129

Hence, ‘129’ is the correct answer.
